en-US.title: Published note and slide examples
en-US.intro: These first-party App Store screenshots show a handwritten note page and a composed slide layout. They are published app examples, not customer testimonials, independent tests or verified export samples.
en-US.store_label: View the app on the App Store
en-US.unavailable: No reviewed public image currently passes the evidence and crawlability checks.

evidence.rights_basis: The publisher's already-public app screenshot contains its note interface, short factual study notes and a simple hand-drawn diagram; no identifiable person, private patient record, third-party photograph or borrowed review is present. This is not a new licence grant for the image.

en-US.alt: A 100 Notes Studio page titled Neurology Lecture Notes, with handwritten study notes, checkboxes and a small diagram.
en-US.caption: The published example shows a filled note page with handwriting, a checklist and a drawing on the same canvas.
en-US.nearby_text: For lecture notes that mix writing and sketches, this 100 Notes Studio screenshot shows the resulting page rather than an empty notebook cover.
en-US.limitation: This screenshot shows the note canvas only. It does not verify PDF export, audio playback, an iPad workflow or a particular free-versus-paid entitlement.

evidence.rights_basis: The publisher's already-public app screenshot contains its slide editor and an illustrative coffee-launch layout made from text and simple charts. It contains no identifiable person, third-party photograph or customer testimonial. The example's figures are not presented as business results.

en-US.alt: OnePage PPT's editor displaying an illustrative coffee-launch slide with a headline, timeline and charts.
en-US.caption: The published example shows a composed slide layout in the editor, above the layout and export controls.
en-US.nearby_text: For turning an outline into a visual brief, this OnePage PPT screenshot shows the composed slide on screen. The coffee-launch content is an example, not a real business case study.
en-US.limitation: A visible Export button does not prove an editable PPTX export. No downloaded file, round-trip edit test or measured productivity benefit is claimed here.

rejected_candidates.reason: Published portrait comparison lacks source-photo licence and model-release proof; do not imply independently measured restoration.
A native Japanese caption does not replace missing source-photo licence and likeness-rights evidence.
An activity interface is not a completed tracing or learning result; illustration rights are not documented in this inventory.
A sound-selection interface does not demonstrate a completed learner result.
A localized phonetic map does not prove the completed tracing result sought by the image task.
Document thumbnails do not prove readable exported scans or a receipt-body search hit.
The notebook-style picker is not a completed note or export result.
The content tray is an input state, not a composed or exported slide.
